sampleValues.Divine Name & Sacred Titles: Solenne, Keeper of the Unbroken Lantern
sampleValues.Portfolio / Domains: Sun & Dawn, Wisdom & Stars, Healing & Mercy
sampleValues.Sacred Symbols, Colors & Beasts: Seven-rayed amber lantern, gold & ivory, white crane
sampleValues.Avatars & Omens: Appears as a blindfold-wearing traveler carrying a glowing brazier; sudden warm wind in winter signals blessing.
sampleValues.Core Commandments & Taboos: Never turn a freezing stranger from your threshold; extinguishing a shrine lamp out of spite incurs seven years of starless nights.
sampleValues.Offerings, Holidays & Priesthood: Beeswax candles, first-pressed olive oil, and written confessions burned at the Solstice Vigil.
sampleValues.Miracles & Divine Blessings: Can purge plague miasma within temple walls and illuminate hidden illusions.
sampleValues.Allies, Rivals & Mythic Deeds:
Vaelen the Storm-Forger | Twin Rival | Divided the sky into day and tempest
Morrow-Child | Adopted Herald | Found the first ember beneath the sea
